title: Action Panel
description: A settings panel composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Switch, Button, Card, Skeleton and Alert primitives: one row per setting, each with a title, a line of description and either a Switch that applies at once or a Button, with a destructive variant for a danger zone and its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — each row's control moves beside its text at @sm, the heading steps up at @md and the heading moves beside the panel at @lg.
